snippet.title: VAGRIENT - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681570/VAGRIENT/

VAGRIENT is a unique everlasting adventure with future expansion updates to come! It provides a compelling, non-linear and open world experience.

Play as an Armlys alien named Vagrient in this sci-fi action/adventure game, featuring RPG elements. It's full of exploration, combat, character progression, puzzle solving and obstacle clearing!
